headline: RED / Marginal Decline — 4th Consecutive Red Session, But Breadth Improves Sharply
marketPulseNote: NEPSE closed marginally red on June 9, 2026 at 2733.59, down just 1.54 points (-0.05%) — the smallest loss of the 4-session decline series. Breadth improved dramatically: 105 advances vs 151 declines (vs 43A/222D on June 8), suggesting selling exhaustion. Turnover surged to Rs.6.44B — the highest of the 4-session series and 58% above June 8. Broker 58 (Naasa Securities) made the single largest net buy of the tracked series: +Rs.691.29M (purchases Rs.956.56M vs sales Rs.265.27M). The dominant move was B58 capturing 99.96% of ADBLB86 turnover — 569,800 kitta at avg Rs.1000 for Rs.569.8M. CITY was re-accumulated massively (90,658 kitta at 39.86%) — reversing the June 8 net sell. AKJCL was net bought again. RIDI received a token buy but B58 continued distribution. Finance (-1.01%) reversed from its 3-session green streak. Hotels (+0.13%), Hydro (+0.01%), Manufacturing (+0.26%), Others (+0.29%) were green. NHPC was net sold by B58 for the first time after 3 sessions of accumulation.

netAccum.note: Pure buy 569,800 kitta at 99.96% market share — effectively B58 bought the entire ADBLB86 turnover. Rs.569.8M in a single stock. This is extraordinarily concentrated and is the single largest B58 buy in the tracked series. Likely a strategic/institutional block purchase of this bond/debenture instrument.

Net buy: 90,658 bought vs 25,211 sold — net +65,447 kitta at 39.86% buy share. REVERSAL from June 8's net sell. This is now the 5th session of B58 actively trading CITY. Cumulative net since Jun 4: +101,340+105,821-6,015+65,447 = +266,593 kitta. Strong re-accumulation signal.

Pure buy 37,640 kitta at 71.12% of NFS turnover. No sell recorded. Very high conviction. NFS was in the June 5 buy/sell list but now a pure accumulation. RSI 62.92 is bullish above 60.

Net buy: 20,155 bought vs 15,621 sold — net +4,534 kitta. Top transactions stock (2,542 txns). B58 buying into high retail interest — cautiously positive.

Net buy: 42,017 bought vs 21,918 sold — net +20,099 kitta. FIRST net buy in 7 sessions for RIDI! This is a potential reversal signal. However the pattern of 6 consecutive sell sessions followed by 1 buy warrants caution. Watch for confirmation in the next session before acting.

Net SELL: 35,865 bought vs 41,529 sold — net -5,664 kitta. FIRST net sell for NHPC after 3 sessions of accumulation. B58 rotated out marginally. Given the 3-session cumulative buy was ~85K kitta, this small net sell may be profit-taking. Monitor next session.
Pure sell 4,465 kitta at 29.10% market share. CREST was top loser today -9.16% (1289). B58 distributing into prior session's gain (+13.11% on Jun 8). Classic pump-and-distribute pattern.
Pure sell 2,400 kitta of RSML at avg Rs.3,572.86 (13.07% market share). New entrant to sell list. High priced stock — total exit value Rs.8.57M.

keyInsights.title: NEPSE Near Flat — 4th Red Day But Selling Exhaustion Signals
keyInsights.body: NEPSE fell only 1.54 points (-0.05%) — the smallest drop of the 4-session series. More importantly, breadth improved dramatically from 43A/222D (Jun 8) to 105A/151D, suggesting selling pressure is exhausting. The intraday chart shows the index dropping to ~2700 by 13:00, then recovering sharply to close near 2733 — a clear V-shaped intraday recovery. Turnover surged to Rs.6.44B (highest of the series), suggesting institutional buying on dips.

keyInsights.title: B58 Largest Net Buy of Series — +Rs.691.29M Dominated by ADBLB86
keyInsights.body: B58's net purchase of +Rs.691.29M is the single largest net buy in the tracked series (Jun 4: +5.15M, Jun 5: +131.78M, Jun 8: +28.93M, Jun 9: +691.29M). The dominant driver is ADBLB86 — B58 bought 569,800 kitta at Rs.1,000 (99.96% of total ADBLB86 turnover) for Rs.569.8M. This appears to be a strategic block acquisition of this debenture. Excluding ADBLB86, the equity-only net buy is approximately +Rs.121.5M — still the second highest equity net buy of the series.

keyInsights.title: CITY — B58 Reverses June 8 Sell, Cumulative 5-Session Net ~266K Kitta
keyInsights.body: After the Jun 8 net sell of -6,015 kitta, B58 re-accumulated CITY with 90,658 bought vs 25,211 sold — net +65,447 kitta at 39.86% buy share. Tracking the 5-session B58 net: +101,340 (Jun 4) + 105,821 (Jun 5) - 6,015 (Jun 8) + 65,447 (Jun 9) = ~266,593 net kitta cumulative. This is an extraordinary level of institutional accumulation. With 52-week high at Rs.649 vs current Rs.403.90, there is significant upside potential if B58's thesis plays out.

Aroon Up 92.86% dominant. MACD 7.04/6.47 positive. This is a strong multi-signal confirmation. Finance sector was red today (-1.01%) but NFS held relatively well (-0.24%). Watch for sector recovery.

The sell was small relative to cumulative buys (~85K net). Could be profit-taking after NHPC closed +2.14% today. RSI 48.22 still below 50. ADX 8.80 very weak. Maintain WATCH — wait for B58 to resume buying.

keyInsights.title: CREST — B58 Distributed into +13% Prior Day Gain, Now Top Loser
keyInsights.body: CREST surged +13.11% on Jun 8 with B58 as both top buyer (52.66%) and top seller (44.70%). Today CREST was the top loser -9.16% (1289) with B58 selling 4,465 kitta at 29.10%. This textbook pump-and-distribute pattern should serve as a warning for stocks where B58 shows simultaneous high buy and sell activity in the same session.

BUNGAL maintains ADX 41.37 (strong trend), AccDist +645K (bullish), RSI 51.45 above 50. BHCL has ADX 33.26, MACD 14.07 strongly positive, RSI 52.26. These remain the two strongest technical setups in the hydro sector with consistent resilience across the 4-session tracked period.

keyInsights.title: Finance Sector Reversal — Fell -1.01% After 3 Green Sessions
keyInsights.body: Finance Index (-1.01%) reversed its 3-session green streak (Jun 4: -0.22%, Jun 5: +2.77%, Jun 8: +0.26%, Jun 9: -1.01%). BFC, which was the finance sector leader at RSI 78.98 (Jun 8), dropped -1.20% to close at 520.00 with RSI 74.12. NFS held better (-0.24%) and RSI 62.92 remains bullish. The sector rotation out of finance may be temporary — watch for B58 finance buying in the next session.

keyInsights.title: Intraday Pattern — NEPSE V-Shaped Recovery from ~2700 to 2733
keyInsights.body: The intraday chart shows NEPSE fell steeply from the open (near 2740) to a low around 2700 by 13:15, then staged a strong recovery to close at 2733.59. This V-shaped recovery on the highest turnover day (Rs.6.44B) is a bullish intraday signal — panic sellers were absorbed by institutional buyers (led by B58's +Rs.691M net buying). If this pattern holds in the next session, a reversal of the 4-session decline may be underway.
